On Wed, Jun 5, 2013 at 2:57 AM, Mikhail Titov <m...@gmx.us> wrote:
> Hi, all!
>
> Is it possible to use devtools with git sub-modules? I have an R package
> that includes Fortran code that I'd prefer to keep in a separate repo. So I
> set up a git submodule. Now I wonder how to make everything work as
> apparently submodule folders appear empty.
>
> From what I understand, install_github simply pulls a zipball and nothing
> can be done unless it is changed on GitHub side. However it seems to me that
> generic install_git would honestly clone a repo. Would it worth it adding an
> optional --recursive flag while cloning?
>
> M.
